display.name: PostgreSQL
display.description: Migrated from OpenTelemetry demo 33bd823107b1b38eaa88dd4ef625cc16d60475d4. All queries use ClickHouse. Metrics preserve PromQL calculations through ClickHouse SQL; other signals read Collector tables.

spec.query:
SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['k8s_cluster_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'postgresql_table_count'
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['k8s_statefulset_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'postgresql_table_count' AND match(tags['k8s_cluster_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['host_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'postgresql_table_count' AND match(tags['k8s_cluster_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND match(tags['k8s_statefulset_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${k8s_statefulset_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${k8s_statefulset_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT tags['postgresql_database_name'] AS value FROM timeSeriesTags(demo_metrics) WHERE metric_name = 'postgresql_table_count' AND match(tags['host_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${host_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${host_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND NOT match(tags['postgresql_database_name'], '^(?:template.*|postgres)$') AND match(tags['k8s_cluster_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${k8s_cluster_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND match(tags['k8s_statefulset_name'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${k8s_statefulset_name:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${k8s_statefulset_name:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$'))
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

SELECT '.*' AS value, 'All' AS label
UNION DISTINCT
SELECT value, value AS label FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT LogAttributes['db.namespace'] AS value FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND EventName = 'db.server.top_query'
) WHERE value != ''
ORDER BY label

display.description: Queries per seconds. Queries being commits or rollbacks.

SELECT timestamp AS time, if(isFinite(value), value, NULL) AS "A",
  mapFromArrays(arrayMap(t -> t.1, tags), arrayMap(t -> t.2, tags)) AS labels
FROM prometheusQuery(demo_metrics, concat('sum(irate(postgresql_commits_total{postgresql_database_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_db), ',k8s_cluster_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_cluster_name), ', k8s_statefulset_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_statefulset_name), ',host_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_host_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), '])) + sum(irate(postgresql_rollbacks_total{postgresql_database_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_db), ',k8s_cluster_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_cluster_name), ', k8s_statefulset_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_k8s_statefulset_name), ',host_name=~', toJSONString(demo_var_host_name), '}[', concat(toString(greatest(240, {step} * 4)), 's'), ']))'), toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC'))

display.name: Top Queries by Execution Time
display.description: Top-query values are interval deltas. Execution time is seconds; calls and rows are counts over the selected period. Collector-owned queries are excluded.

spec.query:
SELECT max(Timestamp) AS Timestamp, LogAttributes['db.query.text'] AS Body,
  LogAttributes['db.namespace'] AS database, LogAttributes['postgresql.rolname'] AS role,
  LogAttributes['postgresql.queryid'] AS query_id,
  sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['postgresql.total_exec_time'])) AS total_exec_time_s,
  sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['postgresql.total_plan_time'])) AS total_plan_time_s,
  sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['postgresql.calls'])) AS calls,
  sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['postgresql.rows'])) AS rows,
  sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['postgresql.shared_blks_read'])) AS blocks_read,
  sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['postgresql.shared_blks_hit'])) AS blocks_hit,
  sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['postgresql.shared_blks_written'])) AS blocks_written,
  sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['postgresql.temp_blks_read'])) AS temp_read,
  sum(toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['postgresql.temp_blks_written'])) AS temp_written,
  total_exec_time_s * 1000 / nullIf(calls, 0) AS avg_exec_ms
FROM otel_logs WHERE otel_logs.Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(LogAttributes['db.namespace'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${query_db:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${query_db:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND EventName = 'db.server.top_query' AND LogAttributes['postgresql.rolname'] != 'monitoring_user' AND LogAttributes['user.name'] != 'monitoring_user' GROUP BY Body, database, role, query_id
HAVING calls > 0 ORDER BY total_exec_time_s DESC LIMIT 20

display.name: Recent Query Samples
display.description: Recent query samples from pg_stat_activity. The receiver reports postgresql.total_exec_time here in milliseconds.

spec.query: SELECT Timestamp, LogAttributes['db.query.text'] AS Body, ServiceName, LogAttributes, EventName FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(LogAttributes['db.namespace'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${query_db:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${query_db:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND EventName = 'db.server.query_sample' AND LogAttributes['postgresql.rolname'] != 'monitoring_user' AND LogAttributes['user.name'] != 'monitoring_user' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

display.name: Top Queries and Plans
display.description: All top queries are shown, including queries with no plan. An empty plan is expected when monitoring_user cannot EXPLAIN a query, including queries that reference accounting.shipping, which is intentionally excluded from its SELECT grants.

spec.query: SELECT Timestamp, LogAttributes['db.query.text'] AS Body, ServiceName, LogAttributes, EventName FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(LogAttributes['db.namespace'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${query_db:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${query_db:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND EventName = 'db.server.top_query' AND LogAttributes['postgresql.rolname'] != 'monitoring_user' AND LogAttributes['user.name'] != 'monitoring_user' ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

display.name: Wait and Blocker Samples
display.description: Wait fields are captured with query samples. ClientRead commonly means an idle backend waiting for client input; non-empty blocking PIDs and lock fields indicate PostgreSQL lock blockers.

spec.query: SELECT Timestamp, LogAttributes['db.query.text'] AS Body, ServiceName, LogAttributes, EventName FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(LogAttributes['db.namespace'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${query_db:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${query_db:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND EventName = 'db.server.query_sample' AND LogAttributes['postgresql.rolname'] != 'monitoring_user' AND LogAttributes['user.name'] != 'monitoring_user' AND (LogAttributes['postgresql.wait_event_type'] != '' OR LogAttributes['postgresql.blocking.pids'] NOT IN ('', '{}')) ORDER BY Timestamp DESC LIMIT 50

display.name: Longest Query Samples
display.description: Execution duration for sampled queries, in milliseconds. These are sampled query records, not a latency percentile or full query history.

spec.query: SELECT Timestamp, LogAttributes['db.query.text'] AS Body, ServiceName, LogAttributes, EventName FROM otel_logs WHERE Timestamp BETWEEN toDateTime64('{start}', 3, 'UTC') AND toDateTime64('{end}', 3, 'UTC') AND match(LogAttributes['db.namespace'], concat('^(?:', if(has([${query_db:sqlstring}], '.*'), '.*', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(v -> regexpQuoteMeta(v), [${query_db:sqlstring}]), '|')), ')$')) AND EventName = 'db.server.query_sample' AND LogAttributes['postgresql.rolname'] != 'monitoring_user' AND LogAttributes['user.name'] != 'monitoring_user' ORDER BY toFloat64OrZero(LogAttributes['postgresql.total_exec_time']) DESC LIMIT 50
